headline: Corporate Insurers Avoid Major Losses Following Global Microsoft Outage
summary: Most commercial corporate insurers avoided substantial claims payouts following a major worldwide Microsoft service outage that paralyzed global businesses for over 24 hours.
why: Microsoft provides enterprise cloud and operating software infrastructure powering global commerce.

impacts.name: Microsoft Corporation
impacts.why: Corporate insurers absorbed limited losses following the enterprise software disruption.
